title: Rear setback 0 m for plots up to 100 sqm (MPD-2047 Table 7.3, row 1)

citations.clause: Table 7.3 (Minimum Setback Norms for Plotted Housing), row 1

notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.178. Row: '1. Up to 100 0 0 0 0' (Front, Rear, Side 1, Side 2). Same as UBBL p.154 (0 m, ubbl2016_compendium_2020.res_plotted.setback_rear_m.upto_100). MPD-2047 prints row 1 as 'Up to 100' where UBBL prints 'Below 100', so from 2026-08-20 a plot of exactly 100 m² falls in this row; before that date it stays the declared source band gap. effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E), as for Table 7.2.
user_caveat: MPD-2047 Table 7.3 (a): if the permissible ground coverage is not achieved with these setbacks (under specific circumstances), the setbacks of the immediately preceding category may be permitted. Not modelled; check with the sanctioning authority.
